Library Code of Conduct

Simple rules for responsible and fair use of resources.

  • Carry institute ID for issue and access.
  • Maintain silence in all reading zones.
  • Return or renew books before due date.
  • Do not mark, tear, or damage library material.
  • Use digital resources as per license terms.
  • Late returns may attract fines as per policy.
